title.value: Beyond Mahalanobis-Based Scores for Textual OOD Detection
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the focus of the paper, which is about improving out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods beyond the traditional Mahalanobis-based scores in the context of textual data.
title.quote: Beyond Mahalanobis-Based Scores for Textual OOD Detection

extractions.description: The paper introduces TRUSTED, a new out-of-distribution (OOD) detector for classifiers based on Transformer architectures. It focuses on textual data and aims to improve OOD detection by leveraging information from all hidden layers of neural networks and employing a novel data depth-based similarity score. The paper demonstrates that TRUSTED achieves state-of-the-art performance in OOD detection across various configurations.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper's primary focus is on improving the performance of neural networks in detecting out-of-distribution data, particularly in natural language processing tasks. There is no direct emphasis or mention of climate or ecological sustainable development goals, initiatives, or applications.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Deep learning methods have boosted the adoption of NLP systems in real-life applications. However, they turn out to be vulnerable to distribution shifts over time which may cause severe dysfunctions in production systems...

primary_category.justification: The paper does not explicitly address climate or ecological sustainable development themes. It primarily focuses on technical advancements in machine learning and NLP for improved performance and reliability of models in detecting OOD data.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we introduce TRUSTED, a new OOD detector for classifiers based on Transformer architectures that meets operational requirements: it is unsupervised and fast to compute.

primary_sub_category.justification: The work is technical and algorithmic without direct ties to any sub-category related to climate or ecological sustainability. It focuses on improving methodologies for neural network performance in detecting anomalies and not on sustainable development.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our contribution can be summarized as follows: 1. We introduce a novel OOD detection method for textual data... 2. We conduct extensive numerical experiments... 3. We release open-source code and data to ease future research, ensure reproducibility, and reduce computation overhead.

new_primary_category.justification: The content does not introduce new aspects or categories related to climate or ecological sustainable development. Its focus remains within technical advancements in AI and ML.
new_primary_category.quote: In computer vision, methods are more mature thanks to the availability of appropriate deformation techniques that allow for sensitivity analysis.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The topics discussed do not explore sub-categories aligned with new developments in climate or ecological aspects. The paper pertains predominantly to AI advancements.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We first leverage the observation introduced by previous work that all hidden layers of a neural network carry useful information to perform textual OOD detection.
